ios.desc:
Stop losing sleep over expired SSL certificates.

CertWarden monitors your SSL/TLS certificate expiration dates and warns you before it's too late. Built for developers, DevOps engineers, and anyone managing websites — simple, fast, and private.

Add your domains, see their certificate status instantly, and never deal with unexpected downtime from an expired cert again.

KEY FEATURES
•⁠  ⁠Real-time SSL certificate expiration monitoring
•⁠  ⁠Clear visual status — valid, expiring soon, expired
•⁠  ⁠Group domains by project, client, or environment
•⁠  ⁠Detailed certificate info (issuer, chain, validity dates)
•⁠  ⁠Pull-to-refresh and swipe actions
•⁠  ⁠Webhook notifications for status changes
•⁠  ⁠API access for external integrations
•⁠  ⁠Full Dark Mode support
•⁠  ⁠100% native iOS — built with SwiftUI

NO ACCOUNTS. NO TRACKING.
CertWarden doesn't require sign-in or collect personal data. Your domains stay on your device. Period.

FREE TIER
•⁠  ⁠Monitor up to 5 certificates — free forever
•⁠  ⁠Full feature access, no limitations

PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
•⁠  ⁠Unlimited domains and groups
•⁠  ⁠Webhook notifications with multiple endpoints
•⁠  ⁠API access for advanced integrations
•⁠  ⁠Priority support
•⁠  ⁠Pay once, use forever — no subscriptions

WHO IS THIS FOR?
•⁠  ⁠DevOps engineers managing dozens of domains
•⁠  ⁠Freelancers handling multiple client websites
•⁠  ⁠Startup founders who can't afford downtime
•⁠  ⁠Sysadmins tired of manual cert tracking
•⁠  ⁠Anyone with a website and an SSL certificate

An expired SSL certificate means lost visitors, SEO penalties, and broken trust. CertWarden makes sure that never happens.

One app. All your certs. Zero surprises.

quotes.text:
Hey HN! I'm the maker of CertWarden.

I'm a DevOps engineer with 15+ years of experience, and I got tired of manually tracking SSL certificate expirations across dozens of domains — both my own and my clients'. Missed renewals causing downtime is a pain nobody needs.

So I built CertWarden — a simple iOS app that monitors your SSL/TLS certificates and alerts you before they expire. The free tier covers up to 5 certificates, and Pro unlocks unlimited tracking.

Tech stack:
•    Native iOS (Swift)
•    Backend running on Cloudflare Workers
•    Freemium model (5 certs free, Pro for more)

What's next:
•    Web portal/dashboard
•    Webhook & notification integrations (Slack, Discord, etc.)
•    Bug fixes based on early user feedback

I'd love to hear your thoughts, feedback, and feature requests. Happy to answer any questions!
